finding.claim: test_router_key's cloud-suffix scan covers only the classifier, the routing-rule targets and the router key. Row r3 covers every model name in the jobspec and every virtual key in services.tf. It skips the hermes, memex and openviking keys' allowed_models and the provider keys' models lists, so adding 'gpt-oss:120b-cloud' to the Hermes key would pass. Today they are all '*', so the row holds, but the test would not catch a regression there.

fixes.change: stub gateway returns classifier calls with each cases for missing and unexpected calls; the cloud-suffix check in test_router_key now scans every provider key and every virtual key's allowed_models
